title: Fix 409 conflict in APIV2 Company Info E2E description test
summary: Fixed 409 conflict errors in APIV2 Company Info E2E tests by disabling test isolation to allow commits to take effect, and changed Environment Information reads to no longer write the singleton record.
key_points: Test isolation disabled on the APIV2 Company Info E2E codeunit so Commit() takes effect before web-service calls
GetEnvironmentDescription now uses Get() and no longer inserts the Environment Information record on read
TestGetCompanyAndEnvironmentDescriptions restores the original company and environment descriptions after the GET
Environment Information row is now created on first write instead of first read
Fix still has to be validated in NAV, where both test methods are currently disabled
quote: The GET then fails with 409 ("record in table 'Company Information' is being updated in a transaction done by another session").
